transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net landline technical operations, my name is Simon. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Simon, my name is Ursula Bennett. On our home landline telephone, whenever our local NHS medical clinic or pharmacy calls us, the telephone caller display screen says 'International' instead of showing their local 01423 phone number, causing us to ignore the calls thinking they are foreign telemarketers!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon. If I understand correctly, your landline caller display is incorrectly identifying incoming calls from your local NHS clinic and pharmacy as 'International' rather than displaying their local 01423 telephone number. Let me query your line routing profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Our landline number is 01423 881902, account reference SN-551029, registered at 33 Duchy Road, Harrogate, HG1 2ER, security PIN 7180.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that brings up the Yorkshire exchange record.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why would a Harrogate NHS clinic appear as international?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the SS7 signaling translation tables at the Leeds regional tandem switch?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. The tandem switchboard indicates that the incoming Presentation Number translation rule has an incorrect carrier prefix parsing flag.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How does a carrier prefix parsing flag cause local calls to show as international?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When NHS hospital trusts route calls through multi-site VoIP SIP trunks, the tandem switch misinterprets the 01423 prefix as an international E.164 country code.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you correct the translation rule on the tandem switch?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I am submitting a translation profile correction order to the regional exchange engineering team.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does it take for exchange engineering to apply the correction?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Simon? Are you there? The line was completely silent for forty seconds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was waiting for the exchange work order system to assign a technician reference.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will the translation rule fix all NHS incoming calls?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously telephone signaling protocols require synchronized SS7 translation tables to unmask SIP trunk presentation numbers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, I understand the switch tables need synchronizing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The engineering work order has been assigned under reference EX-SS7-99120-Y.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: EX-SS7-99120-Y, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am seventy-eight years old and my husband is recovering at home after open-heart surgery! The cardiac rehabilitation team from Harrogate District Hospital tried to call us three times yesterday with critical medication dosage changes, but because the caller ID said 'International', we didn't pick up the phone! Having his hospital calls disguised as foreign scam calls is endangering my husband's life! I am in complete tears and agony over this!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am querying the SS7 translation tables on the Leeds tandem switch right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do Simon, my husband's life depends on these hospital calls.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the profound anguish, tears, and severe worry you are experiencing, especially with your husband recovering from open-heart surgery and needing critical medication changes from Harrogate Hospital. While our exchange network SLA cannot propagate tandem switch changes instantaneously, I will place an urgent medical priority expedite flag on this exchange order and personally monitor it with network control.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Simon, that reassurance brings me so much comfort.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am adding an emergency medical priority flag to the tandem switch job ticket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long will the medical priority expedite take to propagate?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Regional tandem switch translation updates propagate across the local loop in approximately two hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So we cannot verify the caller ID display on this phone call right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct, the tandem switch requires the two-hour propagation window before incoming clinic calls display the 01423 number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What should we do if the clinic calls during the two hours?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In the interim, I recommend answering any call showing 'International' or 'Withheld' until two o'clock this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will keep a pen and notepad next to the handset and answer all calls today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can I assist with any other feature on your landline handset?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is our voicemail working properly if we miss a call?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, standard 1571 voicemail is active and will record messages if the line is engaged.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That provides an additional safety net for the hospital team.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Simon? Did the line drop again? Why does your headset keep going dead?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was applying a ten-pound goodwill credit to your landline account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for the credit, Simon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented your husband's cardiac recovery status on your account records.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will ensure all future agents understand our medical situation.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our exchange engineering supervisor will monitor the SS7 table update at two o'clock.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that is very thorough.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We want to ensure your husband receives all clinical communications without disruption.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have been very kind and helpful today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude, what was that Harrogate landline number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of our call, it is 01423 881902.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, landline number verified on the engineering ticket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Simon for your urgent help today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been my pleasure assisting. Please give my warmest wishes to your husband for his recovery.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Simon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other landline issue today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net landline technical operations. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
